entries.en: to gnaw, to nibble; loosely, to eat
to gnaw a bone
to ask, to beg, to request

entries.zh: 請託、央求（託人代為請求）
entries.en: to entreat through an intermediary; to solicit a favour
entries.notes: M 欄 T99 污損、co 音難定，然 H「托」與 L rogar 相合，取請託義。

entries.en: to engage, to invite (with ceremony); to send betrothal gifts
entries.notes: M 欄自注疑為 pễg/pêng，字取「聘」，義從以禮相請。

entries.en: to call, to summon (someone over)
entries.notes: H 欄 唍/喚 形近難辨，取「喚」與 rogar 之呼求義相應。

entries.en: to entreat, to beg
entries.notes: H 疑 夾/央，音寫 iang 合「央」，取央求義。

entries.en: to invite
to urge, to advise, to exhort
to ask for, to demand, to want
entries.notes: M 欄並列 chây 與 iau 兩讀，義取「要求」。

entries.zh: 請人白做、央人白幫忙（不給酬）
entries.en: to get someone to do something for nothing; to beg a free favour
to pray (to God)
entries.notes: M 欄殘缺，賴 H「禱」與 L rogar a Dios 定釋。

entries.en: to pray, to beseech (God)
entries.notes: M 欄音寫混雜難解且殘，義依 H「祈」與 L 定。

entries.en: to pray for a blessing, to invoke God's blessing
entries.notes: M 欄含疑讀 po/ho 及難解音節，H「祝」與 L 尚明。

entries.zh: 伏服、敬服（俯伏事奉天主）
entries.en: to bow down, to submit and serve (God)
entries.notes: L 與 H「服」對應較鬆，疑取伏地敬拜、服事之義。

entries.en: to beg for help, to lean on someone's aid
entries.notes: H 疑 賴/類，音寫 nây 合「賴」，義取求助。

entries.en: to entreat earnestly, to press with insistence
entries.notes: M 欄混入西語 con instancia，蓋抄手誤置。

entries.en: to invite, to bid (to a meal)
entries.notes: M 欄後半混入西語並殘，主證在 H「請」與 L conbidar。

entries.en: to entreat and entrust; to solicit someone's help

entries.zh: 位次、座次（疑指請人上座、推讓席位之禮）
entries.en: order of seats, precedence (prob. pressing a guest to the seat of honour)
entries.notes: H「位次」與 rogar 之對應不明，僅能推測為請讓上座之禮語。

entries.en: to request, to demand
